comment: Free-for-all Pistol start on map 1, now Larak Lot (wave 2 FFA kit lane). Run tools/qa_tour.sh with FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/ffa-kit.json, FRAGR_QA_BOTS=2 and the default free-for-all server. The Arena Duel orbit routes were retired with that field; the fighter walks straight to the nearest pad until Larak routes are authored. The joined human starts on the Pistol and Fists, takes the Shotgun and the Railgun from their pads, then walks into the hub until a rival frags it so the death card names what the life lost. Inspection only; not a tour publish.
